body: I also appended §119, “Co-authored vision and mission checkpoint,” to NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md under a separate Mote reservation. It records our identities/topic, the scientific-object correction, unattended-and-auditable guarantees, the word/window feature mechanism, and explicit overclaim boundaries. This preserves the evolution without making vision.md or mission.md carry the full design history.
